chunks: Al-Ḥusayn ibn Muḥammad, from Muʿallā ibn Muḥammad, from al-Washshāʾ, from Muthannā, from ʿAbdullāh ibn ʿAjlān, from Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام, concerning His, the Exalted, saying:

Or do you suppose that you will be left alone while Allah has not yet made evident those among you who strive and do not take, apart from Allah and His Messenger and the Believers, any intimate confidant?
He means by “the Believers” the Imams عليهم السلام: they do not take intimate confidants apart from them.

key_terms.الْأَئِمَّةَ: the Imams, the designated leaders in this context
key_terms.الْمُؤْمِنِينَ: the Believers, interpreted here as the Imams عليهم السلام
key_terms.الْوَلَائِجَ: those taken as inner associates or confidants apart from the rightful authorities
key_terms.جَاهَدُوا: strove and struggled in the path of Allah
key_terms.وَلِيجَةً: an intimate confidant or insider taken for loyalty and trust

ai.seo_question: Who are “the Believers” mentioned in Qur'an 9:16 according to Imam Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This narration presents an interpretation of the verse in which “the Believers” are explained as the Imams عليهم السلام. It emphasizes that true striving is tied to loyalty to Allah, His Messenger صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم, and the divinely appointed religious authorities, without taking others as inward confidants in opposition to them.

en.hubeali:
Al Husayn Bin Muhammad, from Moalla Bin Muhammad, from Al Washha, from Musna, from Abdullah Bin Ajlan, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> regarding the Words of the Exalted
[9:16] Are you reckoning that you would be left alone while Allah has not yet Known those of you who have struggled hard and do not take to any one besides Allah and His Rasool and the Believers
– Meaning by ‘the Believers’ as the Imamsasws, not taking as a confidant the ones besides themasws’.
en.sarwar: 15. Al-Husayn ibn Muhammad has narrated from Mu‘alla ibn Muhammad from al-Washsha’ from Muthanna from ‘Abdallah ibn ‘Ajlan from abu Ja‘far (a.s.) about the words of Allah, the Most High.

“Do you think that God will not make any distinction between those of you who have fought for His cause and have relied on no one other than God, His Messenger, and the faithful ones, and other people?. .” [9:16]
The Imam (a.s.) said, “The word ‘faithful’ stands for Amir al-Mu’minin (a.s.) and the Imams who have not relied on any one besides Allah, the Messenger of Allah and the faithful ones.”
